body.title: Thermostable binders for target TR-9
body.statement: Find sequences that fold to a stable binder against target TR-9 with predicted melting point above 75C.

predicates.proposition: The sequence folds to a binder against TR-9 rather than to an unrelated structure.
The measurement was derived by the objective's stated procedure, not asserted by the claimant.
The stabilising interaction the claim identifies is the one doing the work.
The backbone topology is not one an admitted claim already uses.

awards.title: Qualifying binder
awards.criteria: Predicted Tm above 75C and binding score under -9.0 kcal/mol, reproducible from the stated method.

awards.title: Novel fold class
awards.criteria: Backbone topology not present in any admitted claim.
